caption: Jones v. Ryan
citation_line: Jones v. Ryan, No. 1:23-cv-04557, ECF No. 160 (D.N.J. Jan. 23, 2026)
headnote_district_ruling: Denied parties' motion to quash a nonparty surveyor's subpoena for lack of standing, compelled compliance after finding relevance and no timely objection, and denied a related request to limit or seal discovery in a civil-rights and property-boundary dispute.
qualification_rationale: Consolidates practical Rules 26 and 45 guidance on third-party subpoena standing, unretained experts, enforcement, and sealing in one accessible ruling.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive discovery order; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_screen_exclusion_reason: Routine third-party subpoena, relevance, and sealing dispute without merits or dispositive effect.
